This small maize plot is important for feeding my family, so I will put fertilizer on it even though money is tight. I cannot read, and I have always used the seed I saved from last year's harvest — the improved seed from the cooperative costs too much and I do not know if it will do well. I will spread manure from our animals before ploughing, and my children and I will do most of the work ourselves. For weeding and harvest I may call on a neighbor for a few days.
